newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN POLICE SMASH GOLD-SMUGGLING RING - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN POLICE SMASH GOLD-SMUGGLING RING - REPORT.

text.p: South African police have smashed a syndicate they believe may have smuggled gold worth more than $200 million out of the country over the last 10 years, the Sunday Times newspaper said.
One alleged member of the gang, a dairy farmer, is to appear in court soon on related charges but police believe the theft and smuggling ring has links in top government circles, it said.
Police could not confirm the report.

The paper said that while a year-long investigation by police was under way, the syndicate smuggled more than five tons of gold worth $52 million out of the country, which has stringent gold and currency export controls.
The gold, mostly bought from miners who stole it at work, had been taken out in almost weekly consignments that passed through Mozambique to cover their tracks and ultimately ended up in Europe.
